meghan patrick.bio: Bowmanville, Ontario singer-songwriter Meghan Patrick is a Canadian country artist known for a tough, rootsy sound, emotionally direct writing and multiple CCMA and CMAOntario honours.

michelle treacy.bio: Ottawa-born singer-songwriter Michelle Treacy is a Canadian pop artist known for emotionally direct songwriting, a breakout appearance with Lady Gaga and winning CTV's The Launch.

more or les.bio: Toronto rapper, DJ and producer More Or Les is a Canadian underground hip-hop artist and Backburner member known for witty lyricism, turntablism and a long independent catalogue.

muneshine.bio: Saskatoon-born, Toronto-based producer and rapper Muneshine is a Canadian hip-hop artist whose career spans solo work, production, DJing and collaborations across Canada's independent rap scene.

myles lloyd.bio: Montréal-born singer-songwriter Myles Lloyd is a Canadian R&B artist whose melodic, emotionally candid music explores relationships, vulnerability and modern soul production.

naduh.bio: Vancouver collective NADUH is a Canadian femme-led R&B and hip-hop group that writes, engineers and produces its own music around themes of empowerment, queerness and collective creativity.

nate haller.bio: Waterloo, Ontario singer-songwriter Nate Haller is a Canadian country artist known for energetic live shows, contemporary country production and a run of nationally charting singles.

neverending white lights.bio: Neverending White Lights is the Canadian collaborative project of Windsor-born multi-instrumentalist and producer Daniel Victor, pairing cinematic alternative rock with rotating guest vocalists.

nicole holness.bio: Toronto-born singer and television host Nicole Holness is a Canadian R&B artist known for her work in the group X-Quisite and her later broadcasting career.

noeline hofmann.bio: Bow Island, Alberta singer-songwriter Noeline Hofmann is a Canadian country and western artist whose traditional songwriting gained international attention through the song Purple Gas.

nolan hubbard.bio: Gananoque, Ontario singer-songwriter, producer and multi-instrumentalist Nolan Hubbard is a Canadian artist whose music blends soul, pop, rock and live-looping performance.

nostalgix.bio: Iranian-born, Canadian-raised DJ, producer and rapper Nostalgix emerged from Vancouver's electronic scene with high-energy bass house shaped by 1990s pop and hip-hop influences.

nxsty.bio: Vancouver-born producer NXSTY, born Bowen Sanderson, is a Canadian electronic artist known for heavy trap, bass house and high-impact festival production.

odds.bio: Vancouver band Odds is a Canadian alternative-rock and power-pop group whose witty songwriting and melodic guitar music produced a run of platinum records and Juno nominations.

ora cogan.bio: Vancouver Island singer-songwriter Ora Cogan is a Canadian folk and experimental artist whose music blends haunted acoustic songwriting with psychedelia, country and darkwave textures.

phoenix pagliacci.bio: Toronto artist pHoenix Pagliacci is a Canadian rapper, R&B singer, producer and advocate known for solo work and membership in The Sorority and TRP.P.

pimpton.bio: Regina rapper Pimpton, born Kyriel Roberts, is a Trinidad-born Canadian hip-hop artist whose independent career has helped build Saskatchewan's contemporary rap scene.

quake matthews.bio: Halifax rapper Quake Matthews is a Canadian hip-hop artist who grew from Nova Scotia's battle-rap scene into an award-winning recording career built around direct storytelling and independent releases.
